name: codex-orchestration
description: Credit-saving Codex routing with bounded handoffs, checks, and savings receipts.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration for the current chat with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. It scores every deliverable once, hands executive ownership below 5.0 to GPT-5.6 Terra / High, and retains primary GPT-5.6 Sol / High ownership at 5.0 and above. Real implementation goes to the fixed score-selected model whenever that model is cheaper: Luna / Max at 1.0–2.9, Terra / Medium at 3.0–5.0, Terra / High at 5.1–6.5, Sol / Medium at 6.6–7.9, and Sol / High at 8.0–10.0. Simple conversational answers and routes where the owning executive already matches the implementation model use no implementation handoff. Each producer self-checks; the owning executive checks once, gives at most one correction request, then takes over directly if the correction still fails. Agent exactness is checked once per task, waiting is event-driven, and independent review is exceptional and risk-triggered. Every task retains immutable complexity, interruption handling, and the three-line savings receipt with an official-rate fallback. Completed-task tracking includes exact tokens, elapsed time, and delegation count. Daily upstream review never merges automatically and stays off the user's critical path. Accepted fork changes finish on jessejaffe/codex-orchestration main.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” to save credits with one bounded implementation handoff and acceptance loop.
